description: Acid-base titration calculator — Acid-base titration solver: equivalence-point volume, initial pH, pH at half-equivalence (= pKa for weak acids), pH at the equivalence point, a recommended indicator, and a 15-point titration curve - or the pH at a specific added volume= (mL) with its region (buffer / equivalence / excess). analyte= a known acid or base (acetic acid, formic acid, HF, HCN, HCl, HNO3, H2SO4, NaOH, KOH, Ba(OH)2, ammonia, methylamine, pyridine, aniline...) or analyte_type=strong-acid|weak-acid|strong-base|weak-base with pka= / pkb=. Needs analyte_conc= (M), analyte_volume= (mL) and titrant_conc= (M); titrant= defaults to NaOH for acids and HCl for bases. Exact charge-balance solution (no Henderson-Hasselbalch shortcuts), 25 C. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
